## ! Areas of Concern

## **Spill Containment Receptacles**

Keep your spill containment receptacle free from debris and liquid. Be sure to check your spill containments at least weekly or after each fuel delivery.

## **Vapor Recovery Lines**

The driver/operator of a gasoline cargo tank must ensure that vapor recovery equipment is properly connected and in use at all times during loading. The vapor valve shall be a poppetted dry break valve that is CARB-certified and spring loaded.

## **Tank Integrity**

Fill pipe assembly must be intact and not loose. Inspect weekly at minimum to ensure the threading is maintained tightly.

## Remember to...

### **Pay the annual fee.**

An annual administrative fee is due every year on the date of ATO issuance. To ensure you receive your annual invoice, please update any changes to your contact information by completing a Contact Information Update Form online:

[maricopa.gov/DocumentCenter/View/5581](https://maricopa.gov/DocumentCenter/View/5581)

Paying your annual fee does not renew your ATO.

### **Renew your ATO prior to the pre-set expiration date.**

The Gasoline Dispensing Operations General Permit expires on November 3, 2023 and every five years thereafter, regardless of when your ATO was issued. No renewal fee is required. The renewal application can be found at:

[maricopa.gov/DocumentCenter/View/7035](https://maricopa.gov/DocumentCenter/View/7035)
